note: The repository license file is byte-identical to the upstream license. Files below were read from the pinned commit; nothing was taken from a branch head.

files.deviation: find_all_frozen_nn_linear_names returns sorted(...) instead of list(set) so that the TMoE random initialization order does not depend on PYTHONHASHSEED.

Forward computation unchanged. track_query / query_embed initialized (upstream: torch.empty); checkpoint validation before copying; STCMTrack checkpoints rejected; TMoE alpha mismatch is an error; marker _spmtrack_port_version written on save and required unless allow_unmarked_weights; unused _fusion omitted.

Inherits the training model so TMoE is built once in the constructor (upstream applies it inside load_state_dict); all three templates and masks required (no silent substitution); query state released per sequence; dinov2_full_finetune not supported.
Only model type dinov2; model.ltcp is refused; allow_unmarked_weights passed through; new build string.

Reference selection computed once from the memory length; template size and area factor from the config; invalid boxes do not create templates; memory reset on init and released at the end of the sequence; no segmentation component; non-finite outputs raise.
Refuses pipeline.ctr and any plugin set other than the template mask plugin; no segmentation plugin.

Device from the constructor (upstream: .cuda()); reads the reference selection and new templates from the main pipeline; masks reset on init and released at the end; no KeyError when a batch has no tracking task.
Separate class; the unused classification_score_with_penalty flag is dropped.

Structure and inference settings kept. Anti-UAV410/Anti-UAV datasets, 80 epochs, batch 4, 2048/4096 samples per epoch, torch.compile off and efficiency assessment off follow this paper protocol instead of upstream (170 epochs, batch 128, GOT-10k/LaSOT/TrackingNet/COCO).

not_ported: SPMTrack_full_finetune.py as a model type (dinov2_full_finetune): the upstream builder cannot construct it
modules/dinov2_adapter.py, dinov2_vpt_block.py, eva.py, ia3, mixformer_attn.py, head/conv.py, head/ostrack.py
other upstream configs (GOT-10k, LaSOT, TrackingNet, large / giant backbones, VOT, SAM segmentation)
the LaSOT-specific reference rule (dataset_name == LaSOT and B-378): irrelevant to Anti-UAV
known_upstream_issues_handled: track_query and query_embed are torch.empty (undefined memory); the upstream comment says training sometimes does not converge
inference load_state_dict deletes expert_alpha / use_rsexpert unconditionally (KeyError) and ignores the stored alpha
inference model applies TMoE inside load_state_dict, wrapping the layers again when the cached instance is refreshed
SPMTrack_full_finetune.forward_tracking carries a "has a bug" comment and silently substitutes missing templates
builder branch dinov2_full_finetune calls the TMoE class without the TMoE arguments
pipeline never releases memory_frames / memory_masks of finished sequences; mask plugin hard-codes .cuda()
pipeline indexes context.input_data.tasks[i] with the position of a tracking task
mask plugin on_tracked raises KeyError when a batch contains no tracking task
TMoE target modules are collected with list(set(...)), so the initialization order depends on PYTHONHASHSEED
